notes.title: Update: New Boss & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
🆕 New Boss: Saksenaea vasiformis

Prepare to face a terrifying new foe! Saksenaea vasiformis is a rare and deadly fungus known for causing severe, opportunistic infections. In the game, this boss remains rooted to the ground, much like the infamous Candida Auris. However, Saksenaea introduces a new mechanic: it can sprout turrets that quickly fill the screen with projectiles, creating an intense bullet hell experience. Destroy the turrets before they overwhelm you!


🛠 Bug Fixes :

- Addressed several minor bugs affecting upgrades, ally mechanics, and enemy behavior.

- Enhanced stability and performance for a smoother experience.


⚖️ Gameplay Balancing :

- Adjusted boss difficulty to better align with normal and hard modes, ensuring a more refined challenge curve.

- Fine-tuned various interactions and visual elements to improve clarity and immersion during battles.


This update not only brings a thrilling new boss encounter but also resolves critical issues and tweaks gameplay to keep things engaging for both new and returning players.
Dive back in, test your skills, and let us know what you think! Are you ready??
